description: Local executable sandbox access gateway baseline. It validates sandbox token shape, scope enforcement, rate limit visibility and redacted audit evidence without claiming a public token issuer.
privacyBoundary: Gateway evidence must not store real token values, secrets, account identifiers, production URLs, webhook secrets, DSNs, user data, report bodies or non-Beijing real places.

configuration.storageBoundary: Environment-only local smoke input; never commit token material.

audit.redaction: actor subject and target are hashed; token values are never logged

requiredChecks: allowed scope executes a fixture through CapabilityExecutor
rate limit rejects the second request when configured to one request per minute
audit event is emitted without token material
OpenAPI exposes the sandbox gateway path

negativeRules: FATE_API_TOKEN and record-scoped user tokens cannot be reported as sandbox token issuer evidence.
Local FATE_SANDBOX_TOKENS smoke input cannot be reported as public sandbox token service evidence.
Docs smoke or fixed snapshots cannot be reported as token issuance, revocation or external gateway evidence.
Gateway evidence must not include raw token strings, raw subject identifiers, callback URLs or report bodies.
